name: Storm
overview: Scripture portrays storms as powerful manifestations of God's sovereign control over nature, demonstrated when He calms the sea and stills the winds, as Jesus did by commanding peace and great calm. The Lord is depicted as a refuge and strength amid distress, sheltering the needy from the fierce blasts likened to storms. Believers are encouraged to build their lives on the solid foundation of God's word, which guides and sustains them through life's turbulent trials.
